title: Dropdown
hint: The two buttons sit in the lower part of the dashed box. Open Default: the menu runs out of the box and is cut off. Open Auto position: the menu opens upwards and stays complete.
tweak: In the JavaScript tab, set flip to "none" and stick to "none": the second menu is cut off like the first one.

scenarios.name: without the library the menu opens below the button
with the library the menu opens above the button when there is no room below
